name: HZ_PERSON_PROFILES_CX
description:
The profile index table stores value change information for profile
records in the history table. This information is extracted from the history table after it
was updated by a batch or real-time process. Later, this information is used to find rows
in the history table which contributed attribute values to the current profile record and 
obtain source information for each value from that row.

columns.name: RECORD_DATE
columns.description: Last update of the profile record in the history table.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the profile record in the history table.

columns.name: RECORD_VERSION
columns.description: Version of the profile record in the history table.

columns.name: VALUE_CHANGE_TARGET
columns.description: The attribute of the profile record whose value was changed. The attribute index between 0 and 999 is defined by the column order in FND column metadata for the profile table.

columns.name: VALUE_CHANGE_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates if the attribute of the profile record was changed to a different value (C), initialized with a value from NULL (I), reset from a value to NULL (R) or updated with the same value (U).
